group.passage:
There is no denying that the Starbucks logo stands out among a plethora of coffee shop logos. Its design of a twin-tailed mermaid, also called a siren in Greek mythology, is unique and memorable. In fact, the Starbucks logo has gone through several design changes over the past few decades.
The shop created its first logo of the twin-tailed mermaid in 1971, hoping that it would lure customers into buying tasty coffee just as the sirens would lure sailors with their beautiful singing. The first logo was brown, and the mermaid was fully visible, holding her tail in both hands. The circular logo design allowed the company name, along with coffee, tea, and spices, to spin around the logo.
In 1987, the company was bought by Howard Schultz, who hired artist Terry Heckler to design a new logo. Wanting to incorporate the idea of a fresh start and new opportunities to grow, Heckler changed the logo’s color to green and gave the logo a makeover, with the mermaid’s breasts covered by her hair. The words “tea” and “spices” were dropped from the wordmark, leaving just two words connected with two stars.
Starbucks underwent another logo design change in 1992. This time, the logo color remained the same but it zoomed in on the mermaid. Part of her tail was no longer visible, nor was her belly button. In 2008, in preparation for the company’s 40th anniversary, Starbucks decided to bring back the original 1971 logo. The company changed the logo color to black and made a modification to the shape, making it quite different from the classic circular design that consumers had been so familiar with. This design, however, was a failure and received huge backlash from the customers.
The latest design change took place in 2011 when Starbucks dropped many of the familiar design elements from its logo. They said goodbye to the wordmark, stars, and outer ring. The logo now focused entirely on the siren, which they enlarged and gave a facelift. Her eyes, nose, and hair were redesigned to be more symmetrical, and they brought back the circular logo with the green background color. This modern design has given Starbucks a new look and created a logo we are so familiar with today.

figures.label: 第1題選項 (A)–(D)
figures.caption: 第1題選項：四個星巴克商標（黑白印刷）
figures.description: 四個選項都是黑白印刷的星巴克商標圖案。(A) 只有圓形的女妖（雙尾美人魚）圖案：放大的臉部正面特寫，頭戴有星形的皇冠，波浪長髮垂在兩側，兩側可見舉起的尾鰭；沒有外圈，也沒有任何文字或星星，右下角有小小的「TM」記號。(B) 雙層圓圈商標：外圈上方印「STARBUCKS」、下方印「COFFEE」，左右各有一顆星；內圈是完整的雙尾美人魚（人物較小），頭戴星冠、長髮垂下，兩側各有一條舉起的尾巴，下方可見波浪狀的尾部。(C) 外形不是單純圓形的商標：圓形兩側各接一條橫向的長方形帶；外圈上方印「STARBUCKS」、下方印「COFFEE TEA SPICES」，左右各有一個圓點；內圈是完整的雙尾美人魚，雙手舉起握住兩側的尾巴，下方可見尾部。(D) 雙層圓圈商標：外圈上方印「STARBUCKS」、下方印「COFFEE」，左右各有一顆星；內圈是拉近特寫的美人魚，只看得到頭戴星冠的臉、長髮與兩側部分尾巴，看不到肚臍與下半身。

options.A: ［圖］雙尾美人魚放大特寫的圓形圖案，沒有外圈、文字與星星，右下角有「TM」記號
options.B: ［圖］雙層圓圈，外圈印「STARBUCKS」「COFFEE」與兩顆星；內圈為完整的雙尾美人魚，兩側舉起尾巴，可見下方波浪狀尾部
options.C: ［圖］圓形兩側加橫條的外形，外圈印「STARBUCKS」「COFFEE TEA SPICES」與兩個圓點；內圈為完整的雙尾美人魚，雙手握住兩側尾巴
options.D: ［圖］雙層圓圈，外圈印「STARBUCKS」「COFFEE」與兩顆星；內圈為拉近特寫的美人魚，只見臉、長髮與兩側部分尾巴
